newsitem.title: USA: Successories Q4 Feb 1 net off after charge.
newsitem.headline: Successories Q4 Feb 1 net off after charge.

text.p: Successories Inc said Wednesday the effects of a special $2.7-million reserve to cover relocation costs, computer system replacement and store closings reduced earnings for the fourth quarter ended February 1.

The specialty retailer and catalog company said net income reached $1.9 million, or $0.14 a share, compared to $2.6 million, or $0.47, in the same period a year ago. Sales improved to $18.7 million from $14.9 million last year.
Successories also said operating expenses before the special charge fell, in part because of improved efficiencies that the company expects to continue later this year.
Successories shares closed up 3/8 Wednesday at 6-5/8.
